sections.h1: Trade Show Displays in New York City for 10x10 Booths and Javits Shows
sections.lead_html:
Vision Graphics makes custom trade show displays NYC exhibitors use: fabric backwalls, pop-up displays, and large-format graphics for 10x10 booths, Javits Center shows, and corporate events.

We make the displays, pack them for show shipping, and send them to your advance warehouse or your address.

sections.intro_html: Trade show signage, from hanging signs to floor graphics, does the first job at a booth: it gets noticed from the aisle. Most shows require fire-retardant materials for custom trade show signage in NYC, so ask our team what we can supply.

items.title: Printed Fabric
items.html: Clean color that packs flat. Printed fabric graphics suit backwalls and hanging signs, and they travel well.

items.title: Rigid Panels
items.html: Flat, durable panels for counters and feature walls. Rigid panels hold sharp edges and handle setup well.

items.title: Floor Graphics
items.html: Branded graphics underfoot. Floor graphics guide visitors into your booth, subject to your show's rules.

items.title: Hanging Signs
items.html: Overhead signs that help you stand out from across the hall. Hanging signs are rigged through the venue, and lightweight fabric is common because of weight limits.

sections.after_html: A trade show banner or two can carry a message beside the back wall. See our banners.

sections.h2: Planning for a Javits Center Show
sections.html:
Each Javits Center show sets its own rules in the exhibitor manual. Check yours before you order, and use this list as a start.

  • Deadlines: the advance warehouse window, the artwork due date, and your move-in time
  • Shipping: the advance warehouse address and shipping labels from your manual
  • Hand carry and labor: which setup work you may do yourself and which needs union labor
  • Fire-retardant materials: fabrics and decorations may need certificates
  • Island booths: designs and technical drawings may need to go to the venue
  • Hanging signs: rigging is arranged through the venue
  • Insurance: exhibitors may need general liability insurance

Vision Graphics makes the display and the graphics, and your exhibitor manual covers labor, shipping, and venue services.

sections.h2: Trade Show Displays by Booth Size
sections.intro_html: Booth space is sold in 10-foot steps. Here is what fits in each size and what is typically included. Good trade show display design starts with the booth size.

items.title: 10x10 Booths
items.html: A pop-up display or an 8-foot back wall, a counter, and a side banner. This 10x10 trade show booth setup is a standard size for most shows.

items.title: 10x20 Booths
items.html: A longer back wall, side walls, two side banners, and a counter. A 10x20 trade show booth gives room for demos and a meeting area.

items.title: Island Booths
items.html: Open on four sides, with modular or truss walls and a hanging sign. Drawings may need to go to the venue. We make the graphics and display parts, and our team can talk through a full build.

sections.after_html: A pop-up trade show booth can grow from a 10x10 to a 10x20 when the frame is planned for it.

items.q: How far ahead should I order for a show?
items.a_html: Order as early as you can, and check your show's deadlines in the exhibitor manual. Plan time for the artwork check, production, and shipping to the advance warehouse, which can receive materials in the weeks before move-in. Graphics usually take one to two weeks and portable displays two to three, plus shipping.

items.q: Do you deliver to the Javits Center?
items.a_html: We ship to the advance warehouse address in your exhibitor manual, or to your own address, with the labels your show provides. Javits rules and official contractors vary by show, so we do not promise direct delivery to the building. Send us your manual's shipping page, and we will confirm the options.

items.q: Can you update graphics on an existing display?
items.a_html: Often yes. Send photos of your frame and its model number, and our team will check if new graphics fit. Swapping graphics lets one display work for the next show, and it keeps the frame you already own.

Buy if you exhibit more than once, because a frame you own can take new graphics for each show. Renting suits a single large custom booth. We make displays and graphics you own, and our team can talk through a full custom booth if you need one.

items.q: What file format do you need?
items.a_html: Send vector files (AI, EPS, or PDF) for logos and text, and photos at least 100 to 150 dpi at the final print size, in CMYK color. Bleed varies by display, so our team confirms the specs before printing. Images copied from websites print soft at large sizes.

Javits Center shows typically require fire-retardant fabrics and a certificate on request, and your exhibitor manual sets the details. Ask our team what we can supply for your display before you order. Check for a certificate before you assume any fabric meets a show's rules.
